project_type: React + Vite + TypeScript SPA with Supabase Edge Functions (Deno)
build_system: Vite for frontend, Supabase Edge Functions (Deno) for backend
verification_instructions: 1. Run tsc --noEmit (1 pre-existing error about react-router-dom is acceptable). 2. Run vitest --run. 3. Review changes ensure no regressions.
key_patterns: AI calls go through: callAI() -> supabase.functions.invoke('proxy-ai') -> Gemini API. Brain (askOmicron) wraps callAI with conversation memory and fallback. Edge Functions use Deno with JSR imports.
directory_structure: src/ - frontend React app. supabase/functions/ - Edge Functions (Deno). supabase/functions/_shared/ - shared utilities for Edge Functions.
